title: Bombay High Court Appoints Receiver to Secure Financier's Hypothecated Medical Equipment Pending Arbitration Over Loan Default
case_name: Siemens Financial Services Private Limited v. Nadeem Ahmad Khandey & Ors.
card_summary: Justice Amit Borkar allowed Siemens Financial Services' Section 9 plea for interim protection of a CT scan machine financed under a Rs 1.05 crore hypothecated loan to Nadeem Ahmad Khandey. After repeated defaults, the court appointed a Receiver to take possession for Siemens' safekeeping pending arbitration, barring sale or dismantling, and clarified the order rested on the security and defaults, not fraud.
card_tip: A Section 9 petition can secure hypothecated equipment pending arbitration without proving fraud, where the contract gives the financier a right to possession on default and the asset otherwise risks being dissipated.
verification_notes: LiveLawBiz and SupremeToday.ai agree on the date (19 October 2026), the judge, the loan amount, the hypothecation security, the appointment of a Court Receiver, and the restriction against sale or dismantling pending arbitration. LiveLawBiz also reports the 72-month loan tenure, the arbitration invoked on 13 May 2026 and the Section 9 petition filed on 8 July 2026. Full judgment text was not independently reviewed.
